question: 在 TRAIN OOF 漏报故障设备中，是否在故障前出现 burst/DQ 最大间隔相对自身 7 天滚动基线的持续下降（事件间隔缩短、不稳定性加速），而正常设备没有这种趋势？
reason: Saved CV evidence shows FN=27 with 21 scored below threshold, so the main missed-fault population already has a score but is under threshold. Trial_003 tested generic CE-count surge relative to baseline and was screened out at selection; H6 tests a distinct temporal-clustering signal via max_burst_interval_1h/15m and max_dq_interval_1h/15m, not a raw count surge. One exploration slot remains (used 1/2).
expected: A feature encoding rolling decrease in burst/DQ max interval relative to each device's own 7-day baseline should be higher/positive among FN fault rows than TN rows in TRAIN OOF, giving the single-stage model a recall lift on low-score fault rows.
falsification: The feature shows no exploratory separation between FN and TN in TRAIN OOF (AUC interval crosses 0.5), or the controlled feature experiment fails to improve selection/CV F1 and does not lift any missed faults.
exploration_reason: No saved high/missed contrast diagnostic is available; the saved FN/TN count provides missed-fault evidence but no univariate feature evidence. H6 temporal acceleration is an interaction/trend not directly represented by the existing raw max-interval features; this is a bounded recall exploration using the remaining slot.
